Container.Name: chs-tile-proxy
Container.Overview: Caching XYZ tile proxy for Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) ENC nautical charts. Exposes /tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png suitable for Gaia GPS and other slippy-map clients. Tiles are fetched on demand from the CHS MapServer and cached to disk.
Container.Description:
Caching XYZ tile proxy for Canadian Hydrographic Service (CHS) ENC nautical charts. Tiles are fetched on demand and cached to disk so repeated views of the same area do not hit the upstream service.
Use the URL `http://<NAS-IP>:8001/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png` as a custom map source in Gaia GPS.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the tile server listens on.

Config.Name: Tile Cache
Config.Description: Directory where rendered tiles are cached. Persist this to avoid re-fetching after a container restart.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Python log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

Config.Name: Max Zoom
Config.Description: Maximum tile zoom level the server will fetch. Higher values waste cache for over-zoomed scales.

Config.Name: Cache TTL (minutes)
Config.Description: How long a cached tile is considered fresh, in minutes. Default 20160 = 14 days. Set to 0 to keep tiles forever.

Config.Name: Cache Size Cap (bytes)
Config.Description: On-disk cache size cap in bytes. Default 21474836480 = 20 GiB. Set to 0 to disable eviction.

Config.Name: Rate Limit
Config.Description: Per-IP rate limit applied to /tiles/... e.g. 60/minute, 10/second, 1000/hour.

Config.Name: Upstream Concurrency
Config.Description: Maximum simultaneous outbound requests to CHS.

Config.Name: Max Tile Bytes
Config.Description: Hard cap on upstream response size, in bytes. Default 2 MiB.

Config.Name: Contact (User-Agent)
Config.Description: Optional contact email or URL added to the outbound User-Agent so CHS can reach you. Strongly recommended when public.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted-proxy IPs for X-Forwarded-For parsing. Set to your reverse-proxy IP (or * if you trust the surrounding network) so rate limits use the real client IP.

Config.Name: Allowed Lon Min
Config.Description: Western edge of the geographic allowlist (degrees). Tiles outside the box return HTTP 400.

Config.Name: Allowed Lat Min
Config.Description: Southern edge of the geographic allowlist (degrees).

Config.Name: Allowed Lon Max
Config.Description: Eastern edge of the geographic allowlist (degrees).

Config.Name: Allowed Lat Max
Config.Description: Northern edge of the geographic allowlist (degrees).

Config.Name: CHS Layers
Config.Description: Which ENC layers to render. Defaults to the visible chart layers (skips data-quality hatching).

Config.Name: Upstream Timeout (s)
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for the CHS service before failing a tile request.
